name: openalex-mcp-server
description: Access the OpenAlex academic research catalog — 270M+ publications — via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

OPENALEX_API_KEY.title: OpenAlex API key
OPENALEX_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAlex account key (free from openalex.org/settings/api), sent as api_key= for keyed rate limits. Leave blank for anonymous access.

OPENALEX_MAILTO.title: OpenAlex Mailto
OPENALEX_MAILTO.description: Optional email sent as mailto= to identify yourself to OpenAlex (the polite pool). Separate from the API key.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log level (debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg).

OPENALEX_CLAMP_PER_PAGE.title: Clamp count inputs
OPENALEX_CLAMP_PER_PAGE.description: Clamp oversized count inputs (per_page, semantic-search per_page, sample, slice.limit) to their caps with a notice. Set false to reject them instead.

OPENALEX_FILTER_STRING_INPUT.title: Native filter string input
OPENALEX_FILTER_STRING_INPUT.description: Accept unambiguous native filter strings on search_entities. Set false to require record objects.
